caption: Type #book and a space: the box lists the tags that occur most often with #book.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setValue('Finished Hyperion today. '); e.focus();const P=app.plugins.plugins['tag-pairings']; for (let i=0;i<60 && !(P.index && P.index.rank('book').length>=5);i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));e.setCursor({line:0,ch:e.getLine(0).length}); e.replaceSelection('#book '); P.suggest.trigger(e, app.workspace.getActiveFile(), true); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-item').length<5;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-item').length; if (n<5) throw new Error('items '+n); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-tag')].map(x=>x.textContent).join(' '); if (!t.startsWith('#fiction #scifi #history #nonfiction')) throw new Error('order '+t); return t; })()

eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); const e=l.view.editor; e.setValue('Finished Hyperion today. '); e.focus();const P=app.plugins.plugins['tag-pairings']; for (let i=0;i<60 && !(P.index && P.index.rank('book').length>=5);i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));e.setCursor({line:0,ch:e.getLine(0).length}); e.replaceSelection('#book '); P.suggest.trigger(e, app.workspace.getActiveFile(), true); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-item').length<5;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-item').length; if (n<5) throw new Error('items '+n);P.suggest.suggestions.useSelectedItem(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',shiftKey:true}));for (let i=0;i<40 && e.getLine(0)!=="Finished Hyperion today. #book #fiction ";i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (e.getLine(0)!=="Finished Hyperion today. #book #fiction ") throw new Error('line '+e.getLine(0)); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-item').length<2;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-container .tag-pairings-tag')].map(x=>x.textContent).join(' '); if (!t.startsWith('#scifi')) throw new Error('chain '+t); return t; })()
